decision_question: Does the contract merit draftable publication with no runtime efficacy claim?
acceptance_criteria: Exact identities, bounded writes and data audiences
Independent placement, version and access results
Qualified parity and readback of affected references
Draftable catalog source with synthetic examples and no operational maturity claim

shared_model_or_source_limits: Separate agent contexts and role-specific prompts. Shared model family and frozen files. Reviewers had read-only scope and no private records or live connector tasks.

initial_reviews.finding: The missing evaluation record blocked the frozen draft. Location readback alone did not prove preserved history or access.
Distinct relocation map and receipt. Add explicit read-only modes and separate lifecycle, link form and verification fields.
Source guards alone leave destination and sync races. Constrain link resolution and disclosure by audience.

falsification_hypotheses: Separate complete listings may agree even though the states never coincided.
A reused path can misattribute a preserved historical receipt.
test_results: Synthetic time sequence exhibited equal observed states without concurrent parity. Added common snapshot or interval evidence gate.
Synthetic reused-path case invalidated an unqualified relocation map. Added identity and period to historical mapping.

decisive_evidence: Resolved relative evidence link. Revised guard and readback contract separates placement, descendants, history and access.
Added synthetic cases for timed inventory, reused paths, post-move preservation, link escape and partial guards.
Role and fixture review supports a draftable written contract.
unresolved_items: No live connector execution, comparable baseline or unseen holdout.

limitations: Comparable live host runs and protected holdout not run.
Shared model family and frozen source constrain reviewer independence.
The originating workflow is design provenance, not a run of this version.
follow_up: Reopen on an actual workflow failure or before any operational maturity claim.
